purpose: Compact review memory for DAv2-driven Vulkan performance canaries. This is not a production route table.

entries.model_evidence: Depth Anything V2 vits_140 on RX 9070
entries.latest_observation: After descriptor-diagnostic gating, cleanup callback batching, and graph-dump reentry deferral, a focused RX 9070 vits_140 wide4 smoke measured about 55.0 ms mean / 55.0 ms median / 55.6 ms p95 device-resident forward, with bridge sanity max_abs=1.1846423149108887e-06, CPU fallback 0, and sync readback 0. A post-guard timestamp pass showed about 44.2 ms of GPU work per forward, so the lane is close to sub-50 but still needs residual control-plane reduction or a new FP32 linear plan.
entries.decision: Keep as the current stable safe lane; it is not yet the sub-50 solution.
entries.next_proof: Use FC2/linear timestamp attribution and remaining control-plane counters to choose the next optimization; do not re-run rejected tiled FC2 or broad retire-deferral canaries.

entries.canary_or_path: default stack-planned descriptor-pool lease retired on stack-exit submission timeline
entries.model_evidence: Depth Anything V2 vits_140 repeat-30 and vitl_140 repeat-3 on RX 9070
entries.latest_observation: The repeated-request Windows stack overflow was traced to normal stack-planned recording allocating descriptors from the shared context descriptor pool while frequency submits were suppressed. Per-stack descriptor-pool leasing fixes the repeat-30 vits_140 failure and lets vitl_140 smoke runs complete.
entries.decision: Keep as default descriptor lifetime ownership for stack-planned recording. Do not replace it with eager descriptor_pool_.flush() at stack boundaries.
entries.next_proof: Add a focused regression test or budget gate when stack-planned descriptor counters are exposed directly.

entries.model_evidence: Depth Anything V2 vits_140 on RX 9070

entries.decision: Keep as a generic descriptor-path host-allocation cleanup. This is not a model route, shader, submit, fallback, or readback change.
entries.next_proof: Move from per-dispatch descriptor updates toward a real stack descriptor/binding table only after descriptor slot identity and replay-readiness are proven.

entries.model_evidence: Depth Anything V2 vits_140 on RX 9070

entries.canary_or_path: default behavior-neutral stack-region exit work-batch iterative drain scaffold
entries.model_evidence: Depth Anything V2 vits_140 on RX 9070 plus focused graph-dump tests
entries.latest_observation: end_stack_planned_recording_and_submit() still closes/submits the stack region and drains cleanup inline in the original order, but now prepares a heap-owned exit batch with a typed ordered action list and transfers it into a named context control-plane executor. Focused graph testing observes stage=prepared and stage=drained_inline rows in StackRegionDependencyGraph.v0 stack_region_control_plane_work_batch_rows with drain_mode=prepared_not_drained before the drain, drain_mode=iterative_inline after the drain, drain_action_count=6, drained_action_count=6 only on the drained row, executor_mode=context_control_plane_inline, executor_depth_before=0, executor_depth=1, executor_depth_after=0, executor_reentry_status=not_reentrant, executor_reentry_rejected=0, executor_depth_guard=raii, diagnostic_payload_publish_mode=deferred_after_context_unlock, before_handoff_retained_state_payload_captured, after_finalize_retained_state_payload_captured, retained_state_live_log_reread_count=0, retained_state_deferred_payload_count, submit_topology_preserved=1, submit_elision_enabled=0, source_snapshot_state, stack-internal-temp batch count/bytes, and stack-region handoff batch count/bytes. A short vits_140 wide4 smoke measured about 56.9 ms mean / 56.9 ms median / 57.2 ms p95 with bridge sanity max_abs=1.1846423149108887e-06, CPU fallback 0, and sync readback 0.
entries.decision: Keep as behavior-neutral reporting and flattening scaffold. It does not defer cleanup, remove submits, or authorize the compiled-session bridge.
entries.next_proof: Move diagnostic payload publication out of the stack-exit call path before attempting any lifetime-sensitive source snapshot, retire, finalize, submit, or cleanup deferral.

entries.canary_or_path: Benchmark auto-selects native_private_baton for deep stack-output bridge rows when no explicit deep-split env is set
entries.model_evidence: Depth Anything V2 deeper bridge variants
entries.latest_observation: Native private-baton deep split is the accepted benchmark safe-path policy for stacks deeper than the max-12-block proven rowset. Current no-env RX 9070 evidence passes vitl_140 repeat-3 at about 171.4 ms mean with max_abs=0.00013685226440429688 and vitl_182 repeat-2 at about 199.9 ms mean with max_abs=0.0001678466796875; both auto-select auto_native_private_baton_for_deep_stack, keep CPU fallback 0, and keep sync readback 0. A post-commit vitl_140 guardrail passed on RX 9070, GTX 1080, and RX 6700 XT with timed fallback/readback/copies at zero.
entries.decision: Keep as benchmark default deep-stack policy when no explicit deep-split env is set. Direct native calls still require the native_private_baton env and unproven Python-mediated baton remains blocked.
entries.next_proof: Run the DAv2 multigpu matrix again with the auto policy, excluding vitl_700 unless VRAM evidence changes. Do not broaden beyond the max-12-block chunk rule without separate evidence.

entries.model_evidence: Depth Anything V2 vits_140 on RX 9070
entries.latest_observation: A post-37c8efe full DAv2 vits_140 bridge regression check showed that keeping FC2 tiled active while disabling QKV tiled still failed bridge sanity with max_abs around 1.62. Disabling all exact tiled vision linear rows restored bridge sanity at max_abs=1.1846423149108887e-06. The local per-op route test remains numerically clean, but it is not sufficient evidence for stack-output bridge execution.
entries.decision: Fail closed by default and keep the exact shape on the conservative buffer-linear route until a stack-bridge parity proof exists.
entries.next_proof: Develop a generated LinearPlanContract or replacement kernel whose positive evidence includes full stack-output bridge parity, not only isolated F.linear parity.
